errors.text: The proposed minimum supercell of 200 atoms does not match the required 12x12x12, 3456-atom cell for validating the small SRO contribution.

The hypothesis incorrectly implies that an MTP can directly capture electronic DOS/excitation effects and prevent GGA-PBE/LDA functional errors; these electronic free-energy contributions require separate DFT-level treatment.
The claimed melting-temperature accuracy of ±5 K is unsupported and is substantially stronger than the target's demonstrated free-energy agreement and acknowledged functional/CALPHAD uncertainties.
